findingDetails.title: The purpose line bypasses the recovered-context sanitizer and control-character stripping on the Claude compaction path
findingDetails.scopeProof: packet-purpose.ts is new (185 added lines) and session-prime.ts:228-250,417-421 is new in the range diff; shared-provenance.ts is read-only cross-reference evidence.
findingDetails.case: A spec.md purpose sentence contains an ANSI escape or an instruction-shaped line; after a Claude compaction it is injected as Purpose: at the top of the recovered context, while Pi strips C0 controls from the same text.
findingDetails.description: The new Packet Purpose section is built after handleCompact sanitizes the cached payload and is unshifted without the recovered-payload sanitizer. packet-purpose.ts:109 collapses whitespace but keeps non-whitespace C0/format characters and instruction-shaped prose; Pi strips C0 controls at session-compact-context.ts:203 and Claude does not.

findingDetails.title: The operator-facing hop scenarios and root README do not name the new purpose line
findingDetails.scopeProof: The operator focus names the manual-testing playbook, feature catalog, README and root README; these surfaces are outside the 34-file code target and are assessed only under that focus.
affectedSurfaceHints: root README continuity and resume sections
findingDetails.case: An operator runs the existing session-relaunch, resume or compaction scenario to validate the feature; the scenario passes without checking whether Purpose: appeared, so a regression that drops or renames the line is not caught outside the unit tests and the goal log.
findingDetails.description: The playbook table lists the relaunch (303-305), compaction (285-287) and resume (332) scenarios, but a scoped search of the three linked scenario files for purpose returned no match. The root README resume/compaction/continuity sections (45-47, 522-548) also never mention the purpose row, while the changed local READMEs do document it.

spec_code.notes: D1 label shapes, D2 widened headings and D3 problem-on-compaction-only verified in the security pass; the two prior P1 hop-parity findings remain active.

checklist_evidence.notes: Changed assertions inspected, not executed (read-only iteration boundary); no assertion covers the sanitizer parity found here.

skill_agent.notes: No skill definition or canonical agent file is among the 34 changed files.

agent_cross_runtime.notes: Pi strips C0 controls from the purpose section; Claude does not. P1-002 also remains active.

feature_catalog_code.notes: Feature-catalog entries exist for the relaunch and compaction-history hops; neither entry names the purpose row. The prior pass covered stale entries only.

playbook_capability.notes: The three linked hop scenarios contain no purpose assertion (R2-P2-002).

noveltyJustification: Two new P2 findings against 13 weighted active findings (2 P1 x 5 + 3 P2 x 1); no new P0/P1, and the two prior P1s are carried unchanged.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 34 non-spec files across hooks, continuity writer, command assets, templates and tests; the operator focus adds documentation surfaces.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Security-relevant trust boundaries plus the operator-focus documentation surfaces; the swept path-traversal direction was excluded.
omittedHighRiskTargets: create.sh: the range diff shows only four deleted scaffold lines and no new sink
resume YAML assets: model-mediated instructions that inherit the shared reader behavior

searchLedger.hypothesis: The new purpose section is auto-injected without the recovered-payload sanitizer or control-character stripping.

searchActions.result: The section is built after handleCompact sanitization and unshifted without the sanitizer.

searchLedger.rationale: packet-purpose.ts:109 keeps non-whitespace C0/format characters and instruction-shaped prose; Pi strips C0 controls and Claude does not.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The sanitizedPayload computed at session-prime.ts:176 is discarded and the raw payload is injected.

searchActions.result: wrapRecoveredCompactPayload calls sanitizeRecoveredPayload internally and emits the sanitized value.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The wrapper sanitizes internally; the local variable only feeds the sanitized-length log line.
searchLedger.rationale: No bypass reaches the injected output.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Purpose or handoff-date text reaches a shell command unquoted.

searchActions.result: The date is shell-quoted and a hostile created_at value is covered by a test; purpose text is not interpolated into a shell command.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Shell quoting is present and the hostile-input test covers it; no new sink in the changed lines.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The writer-owned packet_purpose copy can carry credentials or transcript text into continuity.

searchActions.result: The field is a validated one-sentence copy of a repo document; no transcript or credential source attaches to it.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The value originates in repo-authored spec text and carries no secret-bearing path.
searchLedger.rationale: No exposure path found in the reviewed code.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The operator-facing hop scenarios and root README omit the purpose line.

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg -n -i purpose on the three linked hop scenarios and README.md
searchActions.result: No purpose match in the three scenarios; no purpose-line mention in the root README continuity sections.

searchLedger.rationale: The existing operator checks can pass without asserting the new line.

searchLedger.hypothesis: C0 or Unicode format characters survive the shared reader and reach the model context.

searchActions.result: packet-purpose keeps non-whitespace C0/format characters; Pi removes C0, Claude does not.

searchLedger.rationale: The shared reader does not strip controls; only one of the two compaction consumers does.
